comparison.objective: Prepare an insulin pen by performing a safety shot and dialing a dose.
comparison.physical_skill: Remove a shield, orient a needle upward, dial and press a dose mechanism, and handle a small medical device safely.
comparison.success_condition: Shield stored, verified 2-unit shot with timed hold, final 12-unit setting, pen released; needle-contact and orientation caps apply.
comparison.reason: Sequenced dial-and-plunger operation is unrelated to bimanual screening or granular-flow control.
